$comment: Sidebar Extension Schema (Derived). What a kit docks beside the screen — Studio AI, the built-in kit `assistant`, is the first. The shell's KitDock mounts one only while its kit is installed where the person is, so `kit` is required: the sidebar is never the shell's own feature (ADR-0068: everything outside the shell is a kit). Same derived-type mechanism as extension_overlay.v1.

label.$comment: Accessible name of the docked panel

order.$comment: When more than one installed kit docks a panel, the lowest order is docked

kit.$comment: The kit this panel belongs to; docked only where that kit is installed
